hotspots.name: Iran war & Persian Gulf
hotspots.summary: Trump confirmed 'minor' US strikes on Iranian air defences on Qeshm Island late on 6 Nov, and on 7 Nov CENTCOM set up Task Force Iron Gate to extend its blockade to Iran's land borders and the Caspian Sea, US aircraft disabled the blockade-running M/V Huda, and the IRGC lifted its 2,000 km missile-range limit. On 8 Nov the IRGC said two more tankers hit mines in Hormuz and UKMTO reported a tanker fire off Khasab and a new incident east of Khor Fakkan. Israel and the US readied for a possible strike over the weekend, but Trump held off, gave Vance 'a few days' for a deal and said renewed war was 'highly unlikely' if talks progress, as the carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt headed for the region. Rubio said he had 'no progress to report' and called Iran's demands 'outrageous'. Iran keeps seven preconditions, including an end to the blockade, and Hormuz stays effectively closed.

hotspots.name: Russia–Ukraine war
hotspots.summary: Overnight into 7 Nov Russia fired 36 ballistic missiles and 172 drones at Kyiv and other regions, damaging Kyiv's Northern Bridge. On 8 Nov strikes left more than 600,000 people in Dnipropetrovsk region and about 250,000 in Kharkiv region without power, the occupied Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost its external power line and fell back on diesel generators, and Russia said it hit cargo ships at Odesa and Chornomorsk. Ukrainian drones damaged the Mius River bridge on Russia's R-280 supply road to the occupied south. At least 55 have been killed at the Komyshuvakha aid site. US-brokered trilateral talks are due in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 Nov, and France says Europe will take part.

Houthi forces have reportedly advanced to within about 50 miles of Aden, and most Asia–Europe container services still sail around Africa.

news.headline: Israeli drone strike kills man in south Lebanon, first such death since September
news.summary: Lebanon's health ministry said a motorcyclist was killed near Qabrikha; Israel said it hit two suspects watching its troops, as the June disarmament framework lags.

news.headline: Oil crashes nearly 9%: Brent settles at $94.62, lowest since early September
news.summary: WTI settled at $88.12 as traders bet the Democratic sweep of Congress will force an end to the Iran war; benchmarks are down more than 15% this week, and Wall Street had its best day since April 2025.

news.headline: Ukraine, US, Europe and NATO coordinate in Brussels ahead of 10–11 Nov Abu Dhabi talks
news.summary: The European Commission-hosted meeting refined post-war reconstruction scenarios with no concrete outcome reported; Moscow still rejects a full ceasefire and demands Donbas.

news.headline: US sanctions India-run fake ship-registry network serving Iran's shadow fleet
news.summary: OFAC designated 13 people and firms led by Suniel Kumar Sharma, including an 'Eswatini' maritime registry, plus an Istanbul ground-handling firm serving sanctioned Iranian airlines, and warned shippers about fraudulent flags.

news.headline: Trump calls Vance's claim that the Iran war cost the midterms 'largely true' but says he'd do it again
news.summary: Vance said the reason Republicans lost is 'obvious'; Trump defended the war as the only long-term answer to an Iranian bomb, while an AP poll found about 6 in 10 voters call it the wrong decision.

news.headline: Tanker hit by two projectiles north of Qatar, UKMTO says
news.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker struck by two unidentified projectiles about 50 nautical miles north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar; crew condition and damage are unconfirmed and no attacker has been named.

news.headline: IRGC says two tankers and a tugboat caught fire in Hormuz on an 'unauthorised route'
news.summary: The Revolutionary Guard said one tanker hit mines, another caught fire leaving the strait and a tug burned while assisting, and blamed the US for encouraging the route; Fars says the Guard also seized two US LUCAS drones. The claims are not independently confirmed.

news.headline: Ukraine and Russia trade mass drone strikes; Komyshuvakha toll reaches 43
news.summary: Russia says it downed 496 Ukrainian drones, with a fire reported at the Ryazan refinery, while Ukraine says it stopped 105 of 128 Russian drones; Zelensky put the aid-site death toll at 43 as Brussels talks on postwar security entered a second day.

news.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi missile over Medina region
news.summary: The coalition said it destroyed a ballistic missile heading toward the Medina region after a danger warning near the port of Yanbu; the Houthis denied targeting Medina and said they aimed at oil facilities and military bases.

news.headline: Trump weighs strikes, a deal or more pressure as US forces prepare for possible major combat
news.summary: Axios reports the military is completing preparations for a return to major combat though no order has been given; Vance favours a deal, and Qatari mediators are pushing a draft that could restart direct talks within days if both sides accept it.

news.headline: Ethiopia and Sudan close each other's border consulates
news.summary: Ethiopia shut Sudan's consulate in Asosa and gave six staff 48 hours to leave, and Sudan ordered Ethiopia's Gedaref consulate closed, amid claims that Ethiopia hosts RSF drone launches.

news.headline: Brent rebounds about 2% to near $97; gold hits a two-week high
news.summary: Oil posted its first gain in four sessions after the IRGC tanker-fire claims, while gold rose toward $4,134 on US–Iran peace hopes and a weaker dollar.

news.headline: Sudanese army retakes two areas south of El-Obeid from the RSF
news.summary: Military sources say the army recaptured Kazgeil and Abu Qaoud, about 45 km south of the North Kordofan capital on a supply route to South Kordofan, after fierce fighting.

news.headline: Machado backs US election roadmap for Venezuela
news.summary: The opposition leader endorsed a State Department plan to renew the top court and electoral council and have interim leader Delcy Rodríguez call elections within six months.

news.headline: US sanctions network supplying Iran with Chinese shoulder-fired missiles
news.summary: The State Department targeted intermediaries in Belarus, Russia and Nigeria accused of helping Iran buy hundreds of Chinese MANPADS air-defence weapons.

news.headline: Brent jumps 3.9% to settle at $98.29 after tanker attacks
news.summary: Oil rebounded from its lowest close since 31 August as at least five vessel incidents since Sunday and Iran's unchanged negotiating stance revived supply fears; WTI settled at $90.52.

news.headline: FT: Russia agreed to supply Iran with 90 helicopter missile launchers
news.summary: Leaked Russian defence documents show an export order for 90 APU-L launchers for Mi-28 attack helicopters for a buyer the FT identifies as Iran, as Tehran seeks Moscow's backing after the US midterms.

news.headline: Iran sends US a nuclear proposal via Qatar but sets seven preconditions
news.summary: A senior Iranian official told Reuters the proposal will be discussed only after Washington meets seven demands, including lifting sanctions, releasing frozen assets and paying war reparations; the US is said to be reviewing it.

news.headline: Trump says he may have to 'destroy' the rest of Iran, with a decision 'soon'
news.summary: Speaking at the White House, Trump said he would 'rather not destroy the rest of the country if possible, but maybe I'll have to', estimated Iran would need 25 years to rebuild, and said 'you'll know soon enough'.

news.headline: Oil extends rebound in Asia on tanker attacks but heads for a steep weekly loss
news.summary: WTI rose 0.7% to $91.14 early on 6 Nov as UKMTO counted at least five vessel incidents since Sunday, but Brent was still set for a weekly drop of more than 15% on bets the midterms speed diplomacy.

news.headline: Iran says five tankers and a tug caught fire near Hormuz
news.summary: The IRGC and Iran's army said in separate statements that tankers struck mines or caught fire on 'illegal' routes near the strait, and a tug fighting one fire also burned; maritime officials have not confirmed the incidents.

news.headline: Trump meets Russian envoy Dmitriev, predicts a 'big agreement' beyond Ukraine
news.summary: Trump met Kirill Dmitriev in Washington on 5 Nov without disclosing what was discussed, ahead of US–Russia–Ukraine talks set for 10–11 Nov in Abu Dhabi.

news.headline: Russia launches 227 drones at Ukraine overnight into 6 Nov
news.summary: Ukraine's air force said 196 were shot down or jammed by morning, with hits at 14 locations and about 15 drones still in the air.

news.headline: European gas extends rebound above €92 but heads for first weekly fall in six weeks
news.summary: TTF rose on Hormuz-related LNG disruption and EU storage near 74%, while Brent hovered just under $100 and gold slipped toward $4,040.

news.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts two Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Najran
news.summary: The coalition said its air defences destroyed both missiles aimed at the southwestern Saudi city, a day after a missile was downed over the Medina region; debris fell and damage is being assessed.

news.headline: IRGC says two more tankers hit mines and caught fire near Hormuz
news.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said one tanker east of the strait and one inside it struck mines on 'unauthorised' routes with their transponders off; maritime officials have not confirmed the incidents.

news.headline: Trump calls Qatar's emir about ending the Iran war
news.summary: The emir's office said the two discussed Qatar's mediation, with Sheikh Tamim urging continued dialogue to prevent further escalation, as Washington reviews Iran's Qatar-relayed nuclear proposal.

news.headline: Two more Palestinians die of wounds in Gaza; gunfire reaches al-Mawasi tents
news.summary: A medical student hurt in an October strike on the Islamic University died, and witnesses said Israeli fire reached tents of displaced people near Rafah; Gaza's health ministry counts 1,602 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire.

news.headline: Wheat falls below $6 to a four-month low on Black Sea peace hopes
news.summary: CBOT wheat dropped about 2% to its lowest since early July as renewed peace efforts eased the Black Sea risk premium and global supply stayed ample.

news.headline: Brent heads for its biggest weekly drop since 2020; gold slips on strong US jobs
news.summary: Brent near $98 was down more than 13% on the week on hopes of Middle East diplomacy, while gold fell about 1% after October payrolls rose 165,000 against 65,000 expected.

news.headline: Crew member killed on tanker hit north of Qatar; another tanker reports blast near Khasab
news.summary: The Greek operator of the Velos Sapphire said a sailor died when two projectiles struck the empty tanker on 5 Nov, and UKMTO separately reported a waterline explosion on a tanker leaving Hormuz near Oman, whose crew was safe.

news.headline: Missile strike on Taiz market kills at least 20
news.summary: A strike on the Al-Hadara market in Al-Waziyah district of western Taiz killed at least 20 and wounded 15, per the Houthi-run health ministry; government forces blamed a Houthi ballistic missile while the Houthis blamed Saudi Arabia, which denied any flights there.

news.headline: Oil ends week down about 13%, its biggest weekly drop in years
news.summary: Brent settled at $98.32 and WTI at $90.83 on 6 Nov as signs of a US–Iran deal and Saudi and UAE exports returning toward prewar levels drained the war premium.

news.headline: US sanctions eight Canadian money firms over Iran transactions
news.summary: Treasury targeted exchange businesses in Ontario and British Columbia it says served sanctioned Iranian entities, and FinCEN cut crypto exchanger MEXC off from US banks over Iran-, North Korea- and Russia-linked flows.

news.headline: Two missiles strike Iran's Qeshm Island; Qatar says deal talks continue
news.summary: Iranian media said two projectiles hit the Suza area of Qeshm after an aircraft was heard overhead, with no attacker named and CENTCOM calling the situation 'relatively calm'; Qatar denied reports that US–Iran talks had failed, and Trump said 'we are talking to Iran'.

news.headline: Trump confirms 'minor' US strikes on Iranian air defences on Qeshm Island
news.summary: Trump said US forces knocked out an Iranian air-defence system on Qeshm 'in about 15 minutes' while insisting 'we are not fighting' and claiming progress in Qatar-mediated talks; Iran says it downed a US drone, and CENTCOM offered up to $20 million for information on Iran's nuclear programme.

news.headline: Russia fires 36 ballistic missiles at Kyiv days before Abu Dhabi talks
news.summary: Russia launched 36 ballistic missiles and 172 drones overnight, injuring five in Kyiv, killing one in Dnipropetrovsk region, damaging the Northern Bridge over the Dnipro and cutting power, heat and water in parts of the capital.

news.headline: Ukraine hits Oryol missile-parts plant with Neptunes; Saratov refinery on fire
news.summary: Ukraine says Neptune missiles struck the Proton-Elektrotex plant in Oryol, which makes Iskander-M components, while a drone attack set the Saratov refinery ablaze; Russia claims it downed 411 drones.

news.headline: Army allies and RSF trade claims in fierce Kordofan battles
news.summary: The army-aligned Joint Force says it retook Umm Sumayma, Kazgeil, Al-Hammadi and Abu Quoud in North and West Kordofan after two days of fighting, while pro-RSF media claim an ambush and heavy army losses; neither claim is verified.

news.headline: Saudi strikes near Sanaa kill 22, Houthi health officials say
news.summary: The Houthi-run health ministry said strikes on the village of al-Shariya near Sanaa killed 22 people and wounded 30, mostly women and children, a day after at least 20 died at a Taiz market; Saudi Arabia has not commented.

news.headline: IRGC lifts its 2,000 km missile-range limit; Saudi Arabia downs missile aimed at Riyadh
news.summary: IRGC spokesman Gen. Hossein Mohebbi said Iran had lifted its self-imposed cap on ballistic-missile range, without saying it has longer-range missiles, as Saudi air defences destroyed a Houthi cruise missile heading for the Riyadh region.

news.headline: Israeli shelling and demolitions continue in south Lebanon despite June framework deal
news.summary: Lebanon's state news agency reported Israeli artillery fire around Bint Jbeil and south of Tyre, ground searches in Khiam and a demolition in Bani Hayyan; the Health Ministry puts deaths from Israeli attacks since 2 March at 4,390.

news.headline: CENTCOM forms Task Force Iron Gate to choke Iran's land and Caspian supply routes
news.summary: US Central Command said the new task force will extend enforcement of the naval blockade to Iran's land routes and the Caspian Sea, targeting advanced weapons, sanctioned materials, dual-use technology and illicit revenue.

news.headline: Iran's navy says a tanker hit mines east of Hormuz and caught fire
news.summary: Iran's navy claimed another tanker struck mines east of the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire; the vessel was not named and the claim has not been independently confirmed.

news.headline: Houthis claim missile and drone attacks on Aramco sites and Riyadh airport
news.summary: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said six operations targeted Aramco oil facilities, Riyadh airport and Saudi military sites; Saudi Arabia did not confirm any hits, and later issued an emergency stay-indoors alert for Jazan.

news.headline: Explosions heard on Qeshm and in Jask, Sirik and Bandar Abbas, Iranian state TV says
news.summary: Iranian state TV reported blasts across four southern counties on Saturday night without giving a cause, while Tasnim linked them to Iranian forces firing at 'violating' vessels in Hormuz; there was no US comment.

news.headline: US aircraft disable St Kitts-flagged cargo ship M/V Huda in the Gulf of Oman
news.summary: CENTCOM said a US aircraft fired precision munitions at the stern of the M/V Huda after its crew ignored repeated warnings and tried to breach the blockade after visiting an Iranian port; it says 147 ships have been redirected and five merchant ships disabled since July.

news.headline: Toll from Saudi strikes near Sanaa rises to 33, Houthi health ministry says
news.summary: The Houthi-run ministry said strikes on homes in Bani Hushaysh east of Sanaa killed at least 33 and wounded 39, mostly women and children; Saudi Arabia said it was investigating and Reuters could not verify the account.

news.headline: IRGC says two more tankers hit mines in Hormuz; UKMTO reports tanker fire off Khasab
news.summary: The IRGC said two unnamed tankers caught fire after hitting mines while using 'unauthorised routes' through the strait; separately UKMTO reported a tanker ablaze about 8 nautical miles northwest of Khasab, Oman, on the evening of 7 Nov, and the UAE rescued 22 crew from a burning cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman.

news.headline: Khamenei says US midterm results won't change Iran's stance as Qatar mediation continues
news.summary: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said the midterm results would not alter Iran's position and the IRGC dismissed the US land blockade as 'a play on words', while Saudi Arabia's foreign minister held his second call in a week with Qatar's prime minister on de-escalation; AP reports Iran is reviewing Qatari proposals.

news.headline: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant loses off-site power; 600,000 cut off in Dnipropetrovsk
news.summary: A Russian drone hit emergency crews at the Komyshuvakha aid-site ruins, where at least 55 have been killed, while overnight strikes left more than 600,000 people in Dnipropetrovsk region without power and the occupied Zaporizhzhia plant fell back on diesel generators after losing its external line.

news.headline: Houthi missile attack damages Aramco tower in Riyadh's financial district
news.summary: Saudi Arabia said it intercepted two ballistic and two cruise missiles aimed at Riyadh and the south plus one at the Eastern Province, but falling debris blew out windows on several floors of the Aramco Tower in the King Abdullah Financial District, a Reuters witness said; no one was hurt.

news.headline: Russian strikes cut power to about 850,000 in Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions
news.summary: On top of 600,000 left without power in Dnipropetrovsk region, a strike on an infrastructure site in Kharkiv region blacked out about 250,000 people; Zelensky says Moscow is stepping up attacks before the Abu Dhabi talks.

news.headline: Russia says it struck two container ships at Odesa and Chornomorsk and a cargo ship at sea
news.summary: Russia's defence ministry said it hit container ships in Odesa and Chornomorsk ports and a dry cargo ship southwest of Odesa that it claims carried military cargo, plus power substations in Dnipropetrovsk and Zhytomyr regions; Reuters could not verify the claims.

news.headline: Ukrainian drones damage Mius River bridge on Russia's supply road to occupied south
news.summary: Rostov's governor said drone debris damaged the R-280 highway bridge over the Mius River, shutting traffic on a road linking Russia to occupied Mariupol, Melitopol and Crimea, and a drone hit a power substation in Millerovsky district.

news.headline: Israeli strike in al-Mawasi kills two as fire continues across Gaza
news.summary: A strike on civilians in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis killed two and wounded seven, and a drone strike west of Jabalia wounded four, medical sources said, despite the ceasefire in force since October 2025.

news.headline: Trump says renewed war with Iran 'highly unlikely' if talks progress
news.summary: Trump told CNN new attacks depend on whether Iran signs 'a very strong agreement', while Qatar denied talks had failed; UKMTO monitored a new incident 18 nautical miles east of Khor Fakkan.

news.headline: Israel and US readied for a strike on Iran this weekend, but Trump held off
news.summary: Sources said no strike order came and Trump gave Vance 'a few days' to reach a deal, while the carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt left Singapore for the Middle East and USS Makin Island left Japan.

news.headline: Rubio says 'no progress to report' with Iran as he heads to G7 in France
news.summary: Leaving for the G7 foreign ministers' meeting, Rubio called Iran's demands 'outrageous, ridiculous, and detached from reality' and said the US was not on the verge of a breakthrough.

news.headline: Oil slips in early Asian trade as Trump plays down new Iran strikes
news.summary: Brent fell 64 cents to about $97.67 and WTI to $90.51 after Trump's CNN remarks, even as both sides reported ships hit in or near Hormuz.

drivers.how: Hormuz oil flows fell from about 21 to 4.9 million barrels a day. The war premium rises with strike threats and falls on diplomacy: Brent dropped ~7% on 2 Nov on peace-talk signals.
Houthi attacks keep Red Sea tanker routing costly; Saudi crude rerouted to Yanbu now relies on Bab el-Mandeb.
Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian refineries and Western sanctions shift refined-product and crude flows.
Iraqi exports depend on Gulf routes; spillover from a resumed US–Iran war would hit southern output.

markets.name: Brent crude
markets.note: Slipped to about $97.67 in early Asian trade on 9 Nov after Trump said renewed US strikes on Iran were "highly unlikely" if talks progress.

drivers.how: The DRC is a leading copper producer; instability and state export controls on its mining belt affect supply.

markets.name: Copper
markets.note: Extended its slide to about $6.20 as a post-midterm tech selloff hit AI-linked demand expectations.

drivers.how: Ukraine is a top corn exporter through its Black Sea ports.
Shipping attacks near Bulgaria and Odesa raise export costs.

markets.name: Corn (CBOT)
markets.note: Edged up to about $4.42 on 6 Nov but stays near a three-month low on ample US supplies and weak export demand.

drivers.how: Safe-haven demand rises with escalation risk and fades when talks progress.
A Taiwan crisis would be the largest safe-haven shock on the board.

markets.name: Gold
markets.note: Slipped 0.4% to about $4,070 on 6 Nov after strong US jobs data lifted the dollar, but gained more than 4% on the week.

drivers.how: Qatari LNG trapped behind Hormuz forces Asian buyers into the spot market.
Qatar's share of Taiwan's gas imports fell from 33.7% to 10.7% this year, raising its exposure to spot prices.

markets.name: Asian LNG (JKM)
markets.note: Northeast Asian spot LNG eased to about $31.49 on 6 Nov, below the near four-year high in the low $34s reached on 30 Oct.

drivers.how: About a fifth of world LNG, mostly Qatari, normally moves through Hormuz; its closure tightens Europe's winter supply.
The EU ban on Russian LNG takes effect on 1 Jan 2027, and energy sanctions stay until the war ends.

markets.name: European gas (TTF)
markets.note: Fell about 4% to near €87 on 6 Nov, down roughly 15% on the week on hopes of a Middle East settlement, though EU storage near 74% keeps the market tight.

drivers.how: War-risk premiums around Hormuz and ship-to-ship transfer delays in the Gulf tie up tankers and push rates to records.
Sanctions on Russian shadow-fleet tankers shift crude onto mainstream ships.

markets.name: Supertanker rate (VLCC, Gulf–China)
markets.note: TD3C Gulf–China earnings rose 4.4% in week 44 to about $1.35m a day, near record levels as Hormuz risk ties up tankers.
markets.source: ETI Tanker Market Weekly Outlook (TD3C, week 44)

drivers.how: Houthi attacks keep container lines on the longer Cape of Good Hope route, absorbing ship capacity.
Fuel surcharges and Gulf port disruption add to box rates.
A blockade or large drill would disrupt one of the world's busiest container lanes.

markets.name: Container freight (Drewry WCI)
markets.note: Down 1% on the week to $4,389; most Asia–Europe services still sail around Africa.

drivers.how: Ukraine and Russia are major exporters; strikes on Odesa ports threaten shipments.
Attacks on merchant ships raise insurance costs on the main grain export route.

markets.name: Wheat (CBOT)
markets.note: Fell 1.5% to about $5.91, a four-month low, as Black Sea peace efforts and ample global supply eased the risk premium.

drivers.how: Moves with the Gulf war premium; US crude exports have filled part of the gap left by the Hormuz closure.

markets.name: WTI crude
markets.note: Edged down to about $90.51 in early Asian trade on 9 Nov as Trump played down a return to war with Iran.
